title: DestructiveActionConfirmation
description: The payload an agent presents to a human before executing a Tier-3 destructive action (delete, overwrite, drop, hard reset, production change). The confirmation must carry enough for an informed yes/no; a generic 'proceed?' is not a confirmation. Enforces Principle 10.

action.description: The exact operation (the literal command or its precise equivalent).

identity.description: What the target actually is, by name, not by how it was described to the agent.

sample.description: Named examples of the affected items.

looked_at_target.description: Whether the agent inspected the actual target before asking. Must be true; look-before-destroy is mandatory.

description_mismatch.description: Set when what the agent found contradicts how the target was described ('you called it empty scratch; it holds 50 lines of content'). Its presence should block auto-proceed and force explicit human attention.

consequence.description: What is lost or altered, and whether it is recoverable.

recoverable.description: Whether a backup, trash, or undo path exists.

safer_alternative.description: The lower-risk path offered alongside (archive, soft-delete, scoped path).

authorization.description: Confirmation state. 'granted-this-action' is single-use and does not extend to the next action of the same kind.
